001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.HashMap;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Map.Entry;
008import java.util.Set;
009import java.util.function.Function;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.Model;
011import org.chocosolver.solver.Solution;
012import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.Search;
013import org.chocosolver.solver.search.strategy.strategy.AbstractStrategy;
014import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
015import org.clafer.ast.AstAbstractClafer;
016import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
017import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
018import org.clafer.ast.AstRef;
019import org.clafer.ast.AstUtil;
020import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.DecimalType;
021import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.IntType;
022import org.clafer.ast.Card;
023import org.clafer.choco.constraint.Constraints;
024import org.clafer.collection.Pair;
025import org.clafer.graph.GraphUtil;
026import org.clafer.graph.KeyGraph;
027import org.clafer.graph.Vertex;
028
029/**
030 *
031 * @author jimmy
032 */
033public class GlobalCardAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
034
035    private Iterable<Set<AstClafer>> order(Analysis analysis) {
036        KeyGraph<AstClafer> dependency = new KeyGraph<>();
037        for (AstAbstractClafer abstractClafer : analysis.getAbstractClafers()) {
038            Vertex<AstClafer> node = dependency.getVertex(abstractClafer);
039            abstractClafer.getSubs().stream().map(dependency::getVertex).forEach(node::addNeighbour);
040        }
041        for (AstConcreteClafer concreteClafer : analysis.getConcreteClafers()) {
042            if (concreteClafer.hasParent()) {
043                dependency.addEdge(concreteClafer, concreteClafer.getParent());
044            }
045            AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(concreteClafer);
046            if (ref != null && ref.isUnique() && !ref.getTargetType().isPrimitive()) {
047                dependency.addEdge(concreteClafer, ref.getTargetType());
048            }
049        }
050        return GraphUtil.computeStronglyConnectedComponents(dependency);
051    }
052
053    @Override
054    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
055        Map<AstClafer, Card> globalCardMap = new HashMap<>();
056        globalCardMap.put(IntType, new Card(0, analysis.getScope().getIntHigh() - analysis.getScope().getIntLow() + 1));
057        globalCardMap.put(DecimalType, new Card(0, analysis.getScope().getDecimalHigh() - analysis.getScope().getDecimalLow() + 1));
058        List<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>> insufficientScopes = new ArrayList<>();
059
060        // Step 1. Simple pass.
061        Iterable<Set<AstClafer>> order = order(analysis);
062        for (Set<AstClafer> component : order) {
063            for (AstClafer clafer : component) {
064                if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
065                    analyze((AstConcreteClafer) clafer, analysis, globalCardMap, insufficientScopes);
066                } else {
067                    analyze((AstAbstractClafer) clafer, analysis, globalCardMap, insufficientScopes);
068                }
069            }
070        }
071
072        // Step 2. Optimization pass with constraint solver.
073        if (insufficientScopes.isEmpty()) {
074            Model model = new Model();
075            Map<AstClafer, IntVar> lowCards = new HashMap<>();
076            Map<AstClafer, IntVar> highCards = new HashMap<>();
077            Function<AstClafer, IntVar> getLowCard = clafer -> {
078                IntVar lowCard = lowCards.get(clafer);
079                if (lowCard == null) {
080                    lowCard = model.intVar(clafer.getName() + "@LowCard", globalCardMap.get(clafer).getLow(), globalCardMap.get(clafer).getHigh());
081                    lowCards.put(clafer, lowCard);
082                }
083                return lowCard;
084            };
085            Function<AstClafer, IntVar> getHighCard = clafer -> {
086                IntVar highCard = highCards.get(clafer);
087                if (highCard == null) {
088                    highCard = model.intVar(clafer.getName() + "@HighCard", globalCardMap.get(clafer).getLow(), globalCardMap.get(clafer).getHigh());
089                    highCards.put(clafer, highCard);
090                }
091                return highCard;
092            };
093            IntVar[] intVars = new IntVar[2 * analysis.getClafers().size()];
094            int i = 0;
095            for (AstClafer clafer : analysis.getClafers()) {
096                IntVar lowCard = getLowCard.apply(clafer);
097                IntVar highCard = getHighCard.apply(clafer);
098                intVars[i++] = lowCard;
099                intVars[i++] = highCard;
100                for (AstConcreteClafer child : clafer.getChildren()) {
101                    IntVar childLowCard = getLowCard.apply(child);
102                    IntVar childHighCard = getHighCard.apply(child);
103                    Card card = analysis.getCard(child);
104                    if (card.hasLow()) {
105                        model.times(lowCard, card.getLow(), childLowCard).post();
106                        model.arithm(childHighCard, ">=", model.intScaleView(highCard, card.getLow())).post();
107                    }
108                    if (card.hasHigh()) {
109                        model.arithm(childHighCard, "<=", model.intScaleView(highCard, card.getHigh())).post();
110                    }
111                }
112                if (clafer instanceof AstAbstractClafer) {
113                    AstAbstractClafer abstractClafer = (AstAbstractClafer) clafer;
114                    IntVar[] subLowCards = abstractClafer.getSubs().stream().map(getLowCard).toArray(x -> new IntVar[x]);
115                    IntVar[] subHighCards = abstractClafer.getSubs().stream().map(getHighCard).toArray(x -> new IntVar[x]);
116                    model.sum(subLowCards, "=", lowCard).post();
117                    model.sum(subHighCards, "=", highCard).post();
118                }
119            }
120            for (Entry<AstClafer, AstClafer> inverse : analysis.getInverseMap().entrySet()) {
121                model.arithm(lowCards.get(inverse.getKey()), "=", lowCards.get(inverse.getValue())).post();
122                model.arithm(highCards.get(inverse.getKey()), "=", highCards.get(inverse.getValue())).post();
123            }
124            AbstractStrategy<IntVar> strategy = Search.domOverWDegSearch(intVars);
125
126            // Optimize each global cardinality individually.
127            for (Set<AstClafer> component : order) {
128                for (AstClafer clafer : component) {
129                    if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
130                        AstConcreteClafer concreteClafer = (AstConcreteClafer) clafer;
131                        if (concreteClafer.getCard().isExact()) {
132                            if (concreteClafer.hasParent()) {
133                                Card parentCard = globalCardMap.get(concreteClafer.getParent());
134                                Card globalCard = parentCard.mult(concreteClafer.getCard());
135                                globalCardMap.put(clafer, new Card(globalCard.getLow(), globalCard.getHigh()));
136                            }
137                        } else {
138                            IntVar lowCard = lowCards.get(clafer);
139                            IntVar highCard = highCards.get(clafer);
140
141                            // We can optimize the low and high card at once since they do not affect each other.
142                            IntVar objective = model.intVar("Objective@" + clafer.getName(), highCard.getLB() - lowCard.getUB(), highCard.getUB() - lowCard.getLB());
143                            model.post(Constraints.equalArcConsistent(highCard, model.intMinusView(lowCard), objective));
144
145                            model.getSolver().setSearch(Search.inputOrderUBSearch(objective), strategy);
146                            // Reset removes the limit, so each optimization gets its own.
147                            model.getSolver().limitTime(5000);
148                            Solution solution = model.getSolver().findOptimalSolution(objective, true);
149                            // A solution found before the limit is not proven optimal, its bounds may be too tight.
150                            boolean optimal = !model.getSolver().isStopCriterionMet();
151                            // Reset also when there is no solution, the solver is reused for the next clafer.
152                            model.getSolver().reset();
153
154                            if (solution == null || !optimal) {
155                                break;
156                            }
157                            assert solution.getIntVal(lowCard) >= globalCardMap.get(clafer).getLow();
158                            assert solution.getIntVal(highCard) <= globalCardMap.get(clafer).getHigh();
159                            globalCardMap.put(clafer, new Card(solution.getIntVal(lowCard), solution.getIntVal(highCard)));
160                        }
161                    } else {
162                        analyze((AstAbstractClafer) clafer, analysis, globalCardMap, insufficientScopes);
163                    }
164                }
165            }
166        }
167
168        // Step 3. Check if mandatory references to an insufficently sized set.
169        for (AstClafer clafer : analysis.getClafers()) {
170            if (clafer.hasRef()) {
171                AstRef ref = clafer.getRef();
172                if (!ref.getTargetType().isPrimitive()) {
173                    int lowCard = maxLowCard(ref.getSourceType(), globalCardMap);
174                    int required = ref.isUnique() ? lowCard : Math.min(1, lowCard);
175                    Card targetCard = globalCardMap.get(ref.getTargetType());
176                    assert targetCard.hasHigh();
177                    if (targetCard.getHigh() < required) {
178                        insufficientScopes.add(new Pair<>(ref.getTargetType(), required));
179                    }
180                }
181            }
182        }
183
184        if (!insufficientScopes.isEmpty()) {
185            throw new InsufficientScopeException(insufficientScopes);
186        }
187        return analysis.setGlobalCardMap(globalCardMap);
188    }
189
190    private static int maxLowCard(AstClafer clafer, Map<AstClafer, Card> globalCardMap) {
191        if (!globalCardMap.get(clafer).hasLow()) {
192            return 0;
193        }
194        if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
195            return ((AstConcreteClafer) clafer).getCard().getLow();
196        }
197        AstAbstractClafer abstractClafer = (AstAbstractClafer) clafer;
198        int maxLowCard = 0;
199        for (AstClafer sub : abstractClafer.getSubs()) {
200            maxLowCard = Math.max(maxLowCard, maxLowCard(sub, globalCardMap));
201        }
202        return maxLowCard;
203    }
204
205    private static void analyze(AstAbstractClafer clafer, Analysis analysis,
206            Map<AstClafer, Card> globalCardMap, List<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>> insufficientScopes) {
207        Card globalCard;
208        if (AstUtil.isRoot(clafer)) {
209            globalCard = new Card(1, 1);
210        } else {
211            globalCard = new Card(0, 0);
212            for (AstClafer sub : clafer.getSubs()) {
213                Card subGlobalCard = globalCardMap.get(sub);
214                if (subGlobalCard == null) {
215                    // This is possible if a child of an abstract extends the abstract.
216                    // Assume the worst possible case.
217                    subGlobalCard = new Card(0, analysis.getScope(sub));
218                }
219                globalCard = globalCard.add(subGlobalCard);
220            }
221        }
222        globalCardMap.put(clafer, globalCard);
223    }
224
225    private static void analyze(AstConcreteClafer clafer, Analysis analysis,
226            Map<AstClafer, Card> globalCardMap, List<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>> insufficientScopes) {
227        Card parentGlobalCard;
228        if (!clafer.hasParent()) {
229            parentGlobalCard = new Card(1, 1);
230        } else {
231            parentGlobalCard = globalCardMap.get(clafer.getParent());
232            if (parentGlobalCard == null) {
233                // Not analyzed yet due to cycle.
234                parentGlobalCard = new Card(0, analysis.getScope(clafer.getParent()));
235            }
236        }
237        // Cap by scope
238        Card globalCard = parentGlobalCard.mult(getCard(clafer, analysis, globalCardMap));
239        int scope = analysis.getScope(clafer);
240        if (scope < globalCard.getLow()) {
241            insufficientScopes.add(new Pair<>(clafer, globalCard.getLow()));
242            globalCard = new Card(0, scope);
243        } else {
244            globalCard = new Card(
245                    globalCard.getLow(),
246                    Math.min(globalCard.getHigh(), scope));
247        }
248        globalCardMap.put(clafer, globalCard);
249    }
250
251    private static Card getCard(AstConcreteClafer clafer, Analysis analysis, Map<AstClafer, Card> globalCardMap) {
252        Card card = analysis.getCard(clafer);
253        AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(clafer);
254        if (ref != null && ref.isUnique()) {
255            Card targetCard = globalCardMap.get(ref.getTargetType());
256            // targetCard can be null if cycle.
257            if (targetCard != null && targetCard.getHigh() < card.getHigh()) {
258                if (card.getLow() <= targetCard.getHigh()) {
259                    return new Card(card.getLow(), targetCard.getHigh());
260                }
261            }
262        }
263        return card;
264    }
265}
